root_cause: Company story duplicates were repeatedly selected from the same top-ranked recommendation. A previously consumed personal publication capability without a provider post ID allowed orchestration to keep regenerating content, falsely appearing recoverable even though provider mutation uncertainty remained.
prevention: On unique-story rejection before provider mutation, store exactly which source recommendation was rejected and rotate to an alternative source-backed recommendation on the same daily channel without disabling global semantic uniqueness.
Persist excluded recommendation IDs across recovery attempts, preventing a rejected story from reentering rotation within the same calendar day.
If no unique source-backed alternative exists, hold the channel rather than invent a post.

Always read consumed unrevoked day-scoped capability records and preserve the existing no-provider-ID claim for exact provider reconciliation. Never create a second sender or silently reset/consume a second day authority.
Retain LinkedIn commentary length limit, preflight OAuth, person/company identity, readback and safety gates.
production_claim: Requires protected CI, exact deployed Edge parity, genuine organization-admin OAuth, verified individual provider receipts and result ingestion.
